research.transport: reviewed isolated Crawl4AI, robots enforced, no external model

rejected_observations.reason: The previous session adapter identifier could no longer be admitted. Authenticated live discovery supplied the active identity.
The runtime probe built, but its private SDK build did not contain the core phase test target. The phase test was built and run in the main project lanes.

corpus.source: Six 64 KiB public-derived base samples from the existing anchor-cohorts bank.
corpus.derived_members: Deterministic byte masks against each base. The mixed cohort also includes unchanged and full-mask members.
corpus.verify: Both encoders consume the same owned source. Nonempty AMD replies reconstruct byte-for-byte on CPU before candidate frame cost is recorded. Both give the same admitted per-member costs in these cohorts.

scope.amd_wall_time: Request preparation plus the complete one-shot exchange, child and supervisor retirement, and parent byte verification.
scope.cpu_wall_time: CPU encode and reconstruction from the same already-owned source.
scope.device_phase: Host-observed wall time for launches and waiting, including synchronization. It is not device-event kernel time.
scope.decision: CPU completes these inputs sooner. Amortize worker setup and remeasure complete cost before automatic AMD selection.
